items.desc: dmg 208

items.name: Tome of the stilled tongue
items.desc: dmg 208

items.name: Trident of fish command
items.desc: This trident is a magic weapon. It has 3 charges. While you carry it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to cast dominate beast (save DC 15) from it on a beast that has an innate swimming speed. The trident regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn.

items.name: Vorpal sword
items.desc: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, the weapon ignores resistance to slashing damage. When you attack a creature that has at least one head with this weapon and roll a 20 on the attack roll, you cut off one of the creature's heads. The creature dies if it can't survive without the lost head. A creature is immune to this effect if it is immune to slashing damage, doesn't have or need a head, has legendary actions, or the GM decides that the creature is too big for its head to be cut off with this weapon. Such a creature instead takes an extra 6d8 slashing damage from the hit.

items.name: Wand of binding
items.desc: This wand has 7 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed. Spells. While holding the wand, you can use an action to expend some of its charges to cast one of the following spells (save DC 17): hold monster (5 charges) or hold person (2 charges). Assisted Escape. While holding the wand, you can use your reaction to expend 1 charge and gain advantage on a saving throw you make to avoid being paralyzed or restrained, or you can expend 1 charge and gain advantage on any check you make to escape a grapple.

items.name: Wand of enemy detection
items.desc: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action and expend 1 charge to speak its command word. For the next minute, you know the direction of the nearest creature hostile to you within 60 feet, but not its distance from you. The wand can sense the presence of hostile creatures that are ethereal, invisible, disguised, or hidden, as well as those in plain sight. The effect ends if you stop holding the wand. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

items.name: Wand of fear
items.desc: This wand has 7 charges for the following properties. It regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed. Command. While holding the wand, you can use an action to expend 1 charge and command another creature to flee or grovel, as with the command spell (save DC 15). Cone of Fear. While holding the wand, you can use an action to expend 2 charges, causing the wand's tip to emit a 60-foot cone of amber light. Each creature in the cone must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute. While it is frightened in this way, a creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can't take reactions. For its action, it can use only the Dash action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If it has nowhere it can move, the creature can use the Dodge action. At the end of each of its turns, a creature can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Wand of fireballs
items.desc: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the fireball spell (save DC 15) from it. For 1 charge, you cast the 3rd-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge you expend. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

items.name: Wand of lightning bolts
items.desc: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the lightning bolt spell (save DC 15) from it. For 1 charge, you cast the 3rd-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge you expend. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

items.name: Wand of paralysis
items.desc: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cause a thin blue ray to streak from the tip toward a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. At the end of each of the target's turns, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

items.name: Wand of polymorph
items.desc: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast the polymorph spell (save DC 15) from it. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed. (can only be used by a spellcaster)

items.name: Wand of the war mage +1
items.desc: While holding this wand, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. In addition, you ignore half cover when making a spell attack. (can only be used by a spellcaster)

items.desc: While holding this wand, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls. In addition, you ignore half cover when making a spell attack. (can only be used by a spellcaster)

items.name: Wand of the war mage +3
items.desc: While holding this wand, you gain a +3 bonus to spell attack rolls. In addition, you ignore half cover when making a spell attack. (can only be used by a spellcaster)

items.desc: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 of its charges to cast the web spell (save DC 15) from it. The wand regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll a d20. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

items.name: Winged boots
items.desc: While you wear these boots, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can use the boots to fly for up to 4 hours, all at once or in several shorter flights, each one using a minimum of 1 minute from the duration. If you are flying when the duration expires, you descend at a rate of 30 feet per round until you land. The boots regain 2 hours of flying capability for every 12 hours they aren't in use.

items.name: Wings of flying
items.desc: While wearing this cloak, you can use an action to speak its command word. This turns the cloak into a pair of bat wings or bird wings on your back for 1 hour or until you repeat the command word as an action. The wings give you a flying speed of 60 feet. When they disappear, you can't use them again for 1d12 hours.

monsters.name: Aboleth
monsters.actions: Amphibious,  Mucous Cloud, Probing Telepathy, Legendary, Lair
monsters.notes: The fetid air hangs thick and heavy, stinging your nostrils with the scent of brine and decay. From the depths of the submerged cavern, a low thrumming resonates in your bones, growing in intensity until the water itself vibrates. Then, it rises. A vast, glistening mass of mottled green and grey, longer than any ship you've ever seen, breaks the surface. Three unblinking eyes, ringed with sickly yellow, pierce the gloom, their gaze ancient, alien, and utterly malevolent. Trails of viscous slime ooze from its flanks, leaving a shimmering rainbow slick upon the water, and two pulsing tentacles lash out, ending in wickedly barbed hooks that drip with a corrosive acid. This is no creature of the natural world; this is something born of a nightmare, something old beyond reckoning, and it hungers for your mind.

monsters.name: Albino Dwarf Warrior
monsters.notes: His beard, the color of fresh snow, hangs to his waist, stained only by the rust-red of old blood. His eyes, devoid of pigment, gleam with an unsettling intensity, like chips of polished obsidian reflecting the torchlight back at you. The echoing clang of his warhammer is rhythmic, relentless, and chillingly devoid of warmth, like the glaciers he seems to have crawled from. He moves with a strength and agility that belies his dwarven stature, an unnatural grace whispering a dark secret in the frozen air he carries with him. He is an anomaly, a nightmare forged in the heart of the mountain, and he is coming for you.

monsters.name: Aldani (Lobsterfolk)
monsters.notes: The air grows thick with the reek of brine and something acrid, like rusted iron. Before you, the murky water churns. From the depths rises a figure both familiar and utterly alien. It stands upright, its bulky frame clad in woven seaweed and scavenged shells. But instead of a face, a hard, obsidian carapace dominates, two immense, clicking claws extended like supplicating hands. Sharp, intelligent eyes, gleaming with a cold, ancient light, peer out from beneath its bristling antennae. This is no mere crustacean; this is an Aldani, a creature of the deep, and it watches you with a calculating gaze.

monsters.notes: The air hangs thick with the stench of damp earth and something acrid, like burnt hair. From the shadowed hollow of the crumbling wall, two eyes glint like greasy chips of obsidian. A guttural snicker, barely audible above the drip, drip, drip of the cavern, heralds the arrival of a creature no taller than a child. Its skin is a sickly, mottled green stretched taut over sharp, bony angles. A rusty, jagged blade, more like a shard of metal than a proper weapon, is clutched in its gnarled hand, and a predatory gleam dances across its face, promising a messy, unpleasant fight.

monsters.traits:
**Hunter's Mark (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest).** As a bonus action, Elara can magically designate one creature she can see within 90 feet of her as her quarry. She deals an extra 3d6 damage to the target whenever she hits it with a weapon attack. If the quarry drops to 0 hit points, Elara can choose a new one as a bonus action on a subsequent turn.

**Favored Enemy: Humanoids.** Elara has advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track humanoids, as well as on Intelligence checks to recall information about them. When Elara hits a humanoid with an attack, the humanoid takes an extra 4 (1d8) damage.

**Favored Terrain: Forest.** Elara has advantage on attack rolls against a creature if the creature doesn’t have all its hit points and the creature is in a forest. Additionally, while traveling for an hour or more in a forest, Elara can't become lost except by magical means.
monsters.actions:
**Actions**

**Multiattack.** Elara makes two attacks with her longbow or two attacks with her shortswords.

**Longbow.** *Ranged Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, range 150/600 ft., one target. *Hit:* 11 (1d8 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) damage against favored enemies.

**Shortsword.** *Melee Weapon Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. *Hit:* 8 (1d6 + 5) piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) damage against favored enemies.

**Reactions**

**Deflect Missile.** In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, Elara can deflect the missile. When she does so, the damage she takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 5. If the damage is reduced to 0, she can catch the missile if it is small enough for her to hold in one hand and she has at least one hand free.

**Spellcasting.** Elara is a 5th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 16, +8 to hit with spell attacks). She has the following ranger spells prepared:

1st level (4 slots): *Hunter's Mark, Longstrider, Cure Wounds, Speak with Animals*
2nd level (2 slots): *Pass Without Trace, Spike Growth*

**Legendary Actions**

Elara can take 3 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. Elara regains spent legendary actions at the start of her turn.

**Entangling Roots.** Elara targets a point within 60 feet that she can see. Grasping roots erupt from the ground in a 10-foot radius centered on that point. That area becomes difficult terrain, and each creature in that area must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be restrained. A creature can use its action to make a DC 16 Strength check, freeing itself or another creature within reach on a success.

**Sudden Fog.** Elara casts *Fog Cloud* as a bonus action, without expending a spell slot. The fog cloud is centered on a point within 60 feet that she can see.

**Swift Dodge.** Elara takes the Dodge action.
monsters.notes: Elara Valthorn is a tall, lithe elf with piercing emerald eyes and long, braided auburn hair interwoven with leaves and feathers. She wears meticulously crafted leather armor, stained green and brown to blend seamlessly with the forest. A longbow, carved from a single piece of ancient oak, is never far from her hand. Her face is stern and weathered, bearing the marks of years spent battling the encroachment of civilization upon the wilds. Elara views the party as a threat to the delicate balance of the forest, believing they are either agents of destruction or heralds of it. She will not hesitate to eliminate them.

ORC TRIBES NORTH OF REDHAVEN

1. The Gron’Vezhul
“The Iron Root”

The oldest tribe—stoic, unyielding, deeply spiritual.

Known for carving homes into the roots of mountain trees and burying their dead with their weapons still clutched.

Believe strength is inherited through blood and stone.

2. The Skullbriar Kin
“We rot. You fall.”

Semi-nomadic orcs who coat their blades with swamp venom and ritually scar themselves after every kill.

Believed to commune with spirits in the marshes.

Their war drums are made from enemy shields.

3. The Embermaw Reclaimers
“We burn to build again.”

A rising militant faction of orcs who believe orcish destiny was stolen and must be taken back.

Formerly peaceful artisans, now militant zealots.

Their armor is scorched and ceremonial, and their mouths painted black in honor of their first firekeeper.

Her face is stern, framed by high cheekbones and a sharp jawline. She wears practical leather armor, darkened to blend with the surrounding trees, and moves with a silent grace that speaks of years spent tracking prey. She carries a longbow crafted from a single piece of yew, its string taut and ready. Mena regards any outsiders with suspicion and open hostility.

savedLocations.name: The Weary Traveler's Respite
savedLocations.description: A ramshackle wooden structure clinging to the edge of the Redhaven wilderness, the Respite is more of a glorified shack than an inn. Weather-beaten and patched with mismatched boards, it offers minimal protection from the elements. The interior is dimly lit by a single sputtering oil lamp and reeks of stale ale, unwashed bodies, and woodsmoke. The common room consists of a few rickety tables and chairs, along with a dilapidated bar. A narrow, creaking staircase leads to a cramped attic space containing straw-filled mattresses for rent.
